title: Equidistribution of primitive quartic torus packets for arbitrary orders
summary: Let K range over totally real quartic fields with no proper intermediate field, and let $`\mathcal O`$ be any order in K . We prove that the packets of periodic diagonal orbits attached to invertible $`\mathcal O`$-ideal classes, weighted by orbit volume, equidistribute with no escape of mass as $`|\mathop{\mathrm{Disc}}\nolimits (\mathcal O)|`$ tends to infinity. The proof combines measure rigidity with a cubic-resolvent estimate that remains uniform at primes dividing the order index.
family_title: Torus-packet equidistribution in prime, quartic, and sextic degrees

review.reason: Shows equidistribution of quartic torus packets for arbitrary orders as discriminants grow.
